verdict.rationale: Loops publishes an API reference covering auth, contacts, events, and transactional endpoints, plus a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, which the probe confirmed returns HTTP 200. None of the evidence shows that the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser, so only the static-reference half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or playground, runnable request examples, and independent corroboration of the reference experience.
